_schema_notes.batch_id: Unique identifier — 'batch_' + UTC timestamp to second resolution
_schema_notes.batch_dir: Relative path to the batch output directory
_schema_notes.variants: Model variants run; default is all 5 (M0/M1/M2/M3/Mstar)
_schema_notes.n_runs_per_variant: Monte Carlo runs per variant (10k website, 100k paper)
_schema_notes.code_sha: Git commit SHA at run time — locks code to data
_schema_notes.data_hashes: SHA-256 of calibration + raw data files (variant → hash)
_schema_notes.seed_bases: Deterministic seed base derived from sha256(model_id|data_hash|batch_ts)
_schema_notes.start_time_utc: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when batch started
_schema_notes.end_time_utc: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when batch completed
_schema_notes.completed_variants: Variants that finished successfully (used by --resume logic)
_schema_notes.failed_runs: Per-variant list of {run_idx, seed, error} for failed simulations

_output_files.manifest.json: This file — written incrementally, atomic rename on complete.
